## The task this checkpoint assesses

This required checkpoint combines a short knowledge check with one practical
artifact. Review lesson notebooks when needed, then complete the final attempt
without copying a finished solution.

## 2. Complete the practical task

Read study sessions from a JSON file, validate each record, skip invalid records with a specific message, and write a summary text file. Deliberately reproduce and investigate one malformed-file failure.

Work in small steps: predict one result, run the smallest useful example,
compare the evidence, and change one thing at a time.

### Evidence to keep

1. Sample valid and invalid input files.
2. A minimal reproducible example for one failure.
3. The exception type, hypothesis, controlled fix, and rerun result.
4. The validated output and generated summary file.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A useful completion check"}
A finished artifact runs from a clean start, contains no unexplained copied
code, and gives another learner enough instructions to reproduce your result.
If one of those statements is false, improve that specific gap before recording
completion.
:::
